required_stages.description: PHI_Q = where(Q > 0, Q + 1, exp(Q)) in fp32 (materialised or fused into the output stage).
PHI_K = where(K > 0, K + 1, exp(K)) in fp32 (materialised or fused into the state/normaliser loads).
S = PHI_K^T @ V, (D, D), reduced over all M rows, TF32-or-better operands, fp32 accumulation.
Z = column sums of PHI_K over M, (D,), fp32 (separate pass or fused into state_s).
O = (PHI_Q @ S) / (PHI_Q . Z + eps); numerator TF32-or-better/fp32-acc, denominator full fp32, eps added once after the reduction.

forbidden_substitutions.message: library GEMM computes a stage of the operator
infix @ matrix multiply on the data path
PyTorch evaluation of the feature map
PyTorch column sum for the normaliser

required_evidence.message: a device-side matrix multiply for S and the numerator
a device-side exp for the feature map
a device-side reduction for Z / the denominator

outputs.aliasing: none: fresh (M, D) fp32 tensor allocated inside run()

timing_boundary.notes: All allocations (O and scratch), any in-run transposed copies and every launch are inside run() and timed; no cross-call cache of PHI_K, S, Z or transposed operands; no prepacked inputs.
